sources.source_retrieval_date: 2026-10-24 (existing checked-in raw feature snapshot); copied to this audit on 2026-10-25
sources.source_crs: ArcGIS feature service EPSG:3857; saved geometry snapshot in WGS84/EPSG:4326
sources.measurement_method: Used first exterior ring of matched source feature. Converted WGS84 lon/lat with the project's documented local approximate conversion (X longitude, Y latitude), computed a shoelace polygon centroid, subtracted centroid for local coordinates, and preserved all 191 ring vertices without rescaling. Local shoelace area is about 2712.56 m2. The Shape__Area attribute is 4688.65 m2 in service Web Mercator and is not directly comparable without projection scale correction.

sources.type: official facility page and building photograph
sources.supports: Bindley identity and interdisciplinary life-sciences research purpose; linked building-specific exterior photograph shows the dark name wall, two/three-level glazed frontage, light metallic panels, entry canopy, and visible lobby.
sources.source_image_date: Image path indicates June 2025 upload; original photograph date unverified.

sources.supports: Research laboratory/core-facility program for interpreted interior lab benches and instrument silhouettes.
Building identity, Discovery Park location, and combined life-sciences and engineering research use.

sources.type: project architect project page and photos
sources.supports: Building-specific exterior photos showing white/silver metal panel cladding, broad glazed volumes, dark entrance signage, and campus-facing landscaped approach; architect states the original center anchors Discovery Park and a significant MCRF laboratory addition extends the building.
sources.source_date: Flad lookbook lists original center completion 2005 and MCRF addition completion 2013.

geometry.coordinate_frame: Local metres, X east, Y north, Z up; origin is area centroid of official GIS exterior ring.
geometry.height_status: Estimated. GIS records three levels, but its Elevation and legacy Extrution values are not verified roof heights. No section or elevation was located.
geometry.envelope: GIS-ring shell and low-slope roof with a light silver panel finish, banded research windows, broad front curtain-wall bay, prominent charcoal entry name wall and canopy, and low-profile schematic rooftop plant screens/vents.
geometry.interior: Small schematic laboratory benches and instrument silhouettes behind glazing. Use-based visualization only; not an as-built room plan.
geometry.facade_status: Color/material, glass, a broad opaque charcoal name wall in front of the lobby glazing, and canopy cues follow building-specific Purdue and Flad photos. Exact location/extent of glazing in the footprint, panel dimensions, bay spacing, roof plant, and unphotographed elevations remain estimated.
geometry.rooftop_equipment_status: Conservatively modeled as schematic low-profile screens and vents with tops at or below 14.50 m, aligned with the prior 14.55 m overall-top estimate. No roof plan or section verifies their locations or heights; the 14.55 m value itself remains estimated.

uncertainties: Official GIS footprint match is by feature ID, building abbreviation, full building name and address; no field survey was conducted.
GIS polygon uses a local approximate coordinate conversion. Web Mercator Shape__Area differs because it is in a projection with latitude scale distortion; the GIS ring itself was retained.

Three levels are recorded by GIS and supported by building-specific photographs, but floor-to-floor and roof elevations are not verified. The eave/top heights remain estimates; rooftop equipment is now modeled conservatively no higher than 14.50 m.

No as-built elevations, roof plan, or traced floor plans were found. Interior objects, mechanical equipment, and facade dimensions are schematic; rooftop screen/vent locations and dimensions are unverified.
The GIS feature ring appears to include the extensive 2013 MCRF addition; the architect source confirms the addition but does not provide a dimensioned addition outline.
Street-level imagery was not independently inspected in this pass.

candidate_grade.builder_self_assessment: Dedicated source module, official source snapshot set, 191-vertex GIS envelope, manifest origin, named collection, and reopen/export validation are complete. The photo-backed charcoal entry name wall is visible in front of the glazed entrance. Rooftop equipment is schematic and conservatively kept at or below the 14.55 m top estimate; that top estimate and all equipment details remain unverified.
